g.text: the only env and YAML reader;
scenario data — a variant is a file,
B's static pose, C closing along x at
the cpm_encode client; restarts on death
the only socket holder; one datagram out
the same JSONL protocol, so the suite
runs with no C++ toolchain and can
inject errors and a deliberate death
stdio: one CpmContent JSON in, one base64 payload out
The wire is unidirectional: nothing on this node binds a listening port.
